units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 1:15">Targ. O. Deut. I, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Exodus 18:21">Ex. XVIII, 21</cite> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. <he>עִישּׂוֹ׳</he>).

<cite ref="Nedarim 39b:16">Ned. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>כעיש׳ דבי רבי</he> like the arrangement in the house of Rabbi (that the first daughter gets one-tenth of the estate, the second one-tenth of the remainder and so on).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 64a">B. Mets. 64ᵃ</cite> top <he>בע׳ וחומשייתא</he> (a reasonable mistake is) a mistake in decades or in fives (where you count by tens or fives).
